MAKERWORLD LISTING: TRINKET TRAY & COASTER MAKER
==============================================================
Copy each section into the matching field of the MakerWorld upload form.
Upload steps are in makerworld/README.md.

Note for you (don't paste this): the "FULL VERSION" link at the end of the description only
works for buyers if the GitHub repo is public. If it stays private, delete that paragraph or
replace the link with your shared Claude artifact link.


MODEL NAME
--------------------------------------------------------------
Trinket Tray & Coaster Maker - Your Logo Inlaid, Multicolor (Customizable)


SUMMARY (short description, if the form asks for one)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Upload any logo and get a multicolor trinket tray or coaster with your picture inlaid flat, text around the edge, patterns and a matching coaster holder. Ready for AMS.


CATEGORY (pick the closest one in the dropdown)
--------------------------------------------------------------
First choice: Household > Kitchen & Dining (coasters) or Household > Decor
Second choice: Household > Organization (trays)


TAGS
--------------------------------------------------------------
coaster, trinket tray, ring dish, customizable, parametric, multicolor, AMS, logo, coaster holder, openscad


LICENSE (your choice; suggestion)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Suggested: Creative Commons BY-NC-SA (people may share and remix with credit, but not sell).
Pick "Standard Digital File License" instead if you don't want remixes shared.


DESCRIPTION (paste everything between the lines)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Make a trinket tray or a coaster with your own logo inlaid in it. Press "Customize", upload a PNG or SVG, choose tray or coaster, pick a shape and colors, and download a 3MF that is ready for the AMS.

WHAT YOU GET
- Up to 4 picture colors, taken from your PNG automatically and inlaid flush (or raised)
- Trays: follow the outline of your picture, round, oval, rounded rectangle, hexagon or octagon, with adjustable walls and an optional colored rim
- Coasters: round, rounded square, hexagon, octagon or the outline of your picture, with a low drip lip, a drip groove and an optional colored rim
- Text around the edge (or straight above and below the picture), with any Google font
- Background patterns: rings, dots, grid, stripes or honeycomb, in their own color
- Underneath: pockets for stick-on rubber or felt feet, or a recess for a cork / felt pad
- Face-down printing for a glossy or textured top straight from the build plate
- A matching coaster holder, placed on the same plate
- Every color is a separate part, so each one gets its own filament

HOW TO USE
1. Click "Customize" (Parametric Model Maker).
2. In "What to make", choose Trinket tray or Coaster.
3. In the "Picture" tab, upload your image. A PNG with a plain WHITE background works best. Crop it tightly around the logo.
4. Set "color_count" to how many colors your logo has (not counting the white background).
5. Open the "Picture colors" tab and pick the filament color for each one. Color 1 is the darkest part of your picture, color 4 the lightest.
6. Set the shape and size in the "Tray settings" or "Coaster settings" tab.
7. Optional: add text, a background pattern, feet pockets, face-down printing or a coaster holder in their tabs.
8. Click Generate, check the preview, and download the 3MF.

TIPS FOR GOOD RESULTS
- Colors are separated by brightness (dark to light). Logos with clearly different light and dark colors work best. Two colors with the same brightness (for example a medium red and a medium green) end up as one color.
- If a color lands in the wrong group, move the "cut_1" to "cut_4" sliders (0 = black, 100 = white). cut_1 splits color 1 from color 2, cut_2 splits color 2 from color 3, and so on.
- Transparent PNGs: transparent areas count as black. Save your picture on a white background first.
- White parts of your picture are not inlaid; the floor shows through, so a white body makes them white.
- "art_height" (trays) and "coaster_art_height" (coasters) set the height of the picture. Keep it smaller than the piece, or the picture gets trimmed at the edge. Leave room for text if you add some.
- Long text: if letters run into the edge, shorten the text or lower "text_size".
- If a picture-outline shape has holes in its floor, raise "outline_smoothing".
- SVG files are inlaid in one color (color 1).
- The cork recess always prints face down. Face-down pieces have no lip or wall, so the top is perfectly flat.
- Hot mugs: print coasters in PETG. PLA softens around 60 °C; it is fine for cold drinks.

PRINT SETTINGS
- 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer height
- PLA (trays, cold-drink coasters) or PETG (hot mugs), no supports, print as generated
- 2 to 3 walls, 15% infill
- Default coaster: 100 x 100 x 4.4 mm, about 15 g; holder for 6 coasters about 25 g
- Default tray: about 101 x 116 x 8.4 mm, about 30 g
- The picture colors only change in a few floor layers (and the rim), so filament waste is low.

NEEDS A MULTICOLOR PRINTER
The picture is inlaid into the floor, so its colors share layers with the body. Use an AMS or another multi-material setup. For a single-color printer, choose art_source "none".

FULL VERSION
There is also a free web app with automatic color detection by hue (not just brightness), a 2D/3D preview, a palette editor and direct 3MF/STL export:
https://github.com/clarkstyx/Trinket-Tray-Generator
--------------------------------------------------------------


PRINT PROFILE NOTES (for the "print profile" step)
--------------------------------------------------------------
- Printer: any Bambu Lab printer with AMS (or another multi-material setup)
- Plate: 1 tray, or 1 coaster (plus its holder behind it when the holder is on)
- Filaments: white, green, black and gold in the samples; the customer's colors replace them
- MakerWorld requires at least one PHOTO OF A REAL PRINT. Print makerworld/sample-coaster.3mf and/or makerworld/sample-tray.3mf and take a photo before publishing.
- The preview-*.png renders can be added as extra pictures.


BILL OF MATERIALS
--------------------------------------------------------------
- Filament: about 15 g per coaster, 25 g per holder, 30 g per tray (mostly the body color)
- Coasters with feet pockets: stick-on rubber or felt bumpers, 10 mm across (or the size you set)
- Coasters with a recess: a cork or felt sheet as thick as the recess depth (1.2 mm by default), cut to shape
